name: agentwatch
description: Watches Claude Code like a production agent: every session becomes an AgentWatch run, risky tool calls are checked before they run, and an operator can stop the agent from the console. Defaults to dry_run.

api_url.title: AgentWatch API URL
api_url.description: Your AgentWatch API. Use your own host for self-hosted AgentWatch.

api_key.title: AgentWatch API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty and run /agentwatch:setup instead: it signs this machine in with a device code you approve in the browser. A key entered here is stored in your OS keychain by Claude Code.

mode.title: Mode (dry_run or enforce)
mode.description: Type dry_run or enforce. dry_run records what would be blocked and never blocks (denied tools and self-protection excepted). enforce blocks denied, held and isolated calls. Anything else means dry_run.
